# README Badge Snippets

Paste any of these blocks at the top of your `README.md`.

---

## Option A — All three badges in a single row

```markdown
[![No AI Training](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20AI%20Training-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,&logoColor=white)](NOTICES.md)
[![No Crawling](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Crawling-FF6600?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,&logoColor=white)](robots.txt)
[![No Auto-Translate](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Auto--Translate-0055AA?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,&logoColor=white)](NOTICES.md)
```

---

## Option B — Simple text badges (no custom icons, always renders correctly)

```markdown
![No AI Training](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20AI%20Training-red?style=flat-square)
![No Crawling](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Crawling-orange?style=flat-square)
![No Auto-Translate](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Auto--Translate-blue?style=flat-square)
```

## Option C — Larger "for-the-badge" style

```markdown
![No AI Training](https://img.shields.io/badge/NO%20AI%20TRAINING-FF0000?style=for-the-badge)
![No Crawling](https://img.shields.io/badge/NO%20CRAWLING-FF6600?style=for-the-badge)
```

## Recommended README header block

Paste this right after your project title/description:

```markdown
---

> **Notices** &nbsp;
> ![No AI Training](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20AI%20Training-red?style=flat-square)
> ![No Crawling](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Crawling-orange?style=flat-square)
> ![No Auto-Translate](https://img.shields.io/badge/No%20Auto--Translate-blue?style=flat-square)
>
> All content in this repository is © the contributors.  
> AI training, automated scraping, and machine translation are **not permitted**.  
> See [NOTICES.md](./NOTICES.md) for full details.

---
```
